title: Broad Sword
description:
Fight and lead your army from a ground level view of large fantasy battles, command your formation of troops, and direct your forces through hack-and-slash encounters to claim ultimate victory! Go head to head in objective based conquest mode. Test your defensive skills in a wave based survival mode, or employ grand strategy in a campaign mode. Varied troop types offer distinct fighting styles and weapons, allowing for diverse playstyles and tactics. Will you anchor a battle line with spearmen, shatter defenses with mighty great swords, or rain arrows upon your enemies? 

Utilize the full roster of available troop loadouts to gain victory!

• Diverse Unit Arsenal: Command more than 70 troop types across 5 factions adding depth and dynamic strategies to class-based battles

• Strategic Formations: Employ formation tactics by adjusting your unit's stance and formation shape while also commanding your army as a whole.

• Wave Survival Siege Mode: Test your skills against increasing enemy pressure as you defend against waves of varied enemies. 

• Multiplayer Mayhem: Challenge your skills against AI bots or friends in local multiplayer.

• Objective Based Gameplay: Battle for control of objectives and manipulate spawn points to strategically choose spawned allies.

Objective based gameplay where you capture objectives to drain your opponent's supplies and achieve victory.

Defend your fortification against increasing waves of enemies to survive as long as possible.

Capture territories in an ongoing campaign to unlock additional unit types and clear your enemies from the region.
description_short: Broad Sword is a formation based third-person tactical hack and slash game where you lead formations of troops to face off against a variety of factions in a fantasy realm. Engage in class-based combat as you defeat your foes in conquest, siege and campaign modes.
